<!--
Thanks for suggesting a feature! Please fill out the sections below so
maintainers can understand the problem and the proposed solution.

Already on the roadmap? Check [docs/ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md)
first — your idea may already be tracked there, and you can add details
to the relevant milestone instead.
-->

## Problem

Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise
description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it
should behave.

## Alternative solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered.

## How it fits the project

- Which area / milestone does this belong to (see
  [docs/ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md))? E.g. Milestone 1 (UX),
  Milestone 2 (open workflow), Milestone 3 (academic trust), Milestone 4
  (advanced features), Milestone 5 (production hardening), or Backlog.
- Would it require new dependencies, new search sources, or database
  changes?
- Rough implementation sketch, if you have one.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples (links, screenshots) here.
